re_audit_notes: Tromp-Zhang-Zhao Section 4 constructs the exact n-by-n row/column-weight-three circulant Hamming object from a trinomial whose gcd with x^(2^k-1)+1 is primitive of degree k.
Their all-k existence statement is Conjecture 1; the paper reports verification through k<=500 after subsequent work.
Kim-Koepf 2009 and Brent-Zimmermann almost-primitive work were checked; no universal all-k closure was located.
Therefore the Hamming (3,3) circulant construction is source-bound, while its universal existence remains an external conjectural barrier.
v1.2: random doubly-3-regular rank theory gives rank/n->1, but full-rank cubic parents collapse to graphic circuit matroids; rank alone is not lift-rank leverage.
v1.2: Imai source-binds the 2D-cyclic torus language. The exact L=7 live-leaf q_graph stress remains a JANUS finite control, not an asymptotic family.
